method: Independent read-only access audit of the recorded source gaps. No personal AI statements were recovered.

findings.redirect_issue: The first Location header uses HTTP. That endpoint redirects back to the HTTPS canonical SI inventory. A direct request to the HTTPS canonical page avoids the HTTP intermediate.
findings.followup: Updated the future research seed to the exact HTTPS canonical page. Retained original role-source URLs and historical run gaps. Institutional inventory text does not establish a named official stance.

findings.note: The HTML requests client-side rendering. Do not infer staff identities or AI views from the page title or generic OCIO metadata.
Names, titles, and biography links establish role-directory content. They do not establish AI views.
